Backend: GET /api/health 200 + {status:healthy, service:'Leader OS Leadership Diagnose'}. Self-heal loop confirmed in backend.err.log: '[stripe-self-heal] loop started · interval=3600s' (multiple iterations observed, one run scanned=53 expired=53). 7/7 self-heal unit tests pass in 0.09s. All 3 CTAs (hero-cta-primary, hero-cta-credits, hero-cta-bottom) present; hero-cta-primary click navigates to /diagnose. AgentsCarouselSection: 6 unique apple-card-0..5 testids confirmed. action_items: Optional: review request example used package_id='leader_os' which returns 400 'Unknown package'. Either add 'leader_os' as an alias in services/pricing.py PACKAGES, or update docs/examples to use the actual valid IDs (leader_os_full / leader_os_plus / standard_yearly etc.). Not blocking — valid IDs work perfectly.
critical_code_review_comments: services/stripe_checkout.py (264 lines) — clean separation: is_real_stripe_key, build_*_metadata, create_subscription_session, apply_subscription_cancel_at, create_one_time_session, build_*_tx, cancel_stale_pending_checkouts, start_self_healing_loop. All async/await proper, all DB I/O via motor, stripe_sdk wrapped in asyncio.to_thread. No _id leakage (projection excludes _id). Self-heal loop wraps each iteration in try/except so one bad run won't kill the loop. Excellent.

routes/payments.py (267 lines, was 416) — thin orchestrator pattern achieved. register_checkout_routes + register_license_routes both <100 LOC each. PACKAGES re-exported via __all__ for backward compat.

Hero.jsx (59 lines) — pure orchestrator, only navigation callbacks + section sequence. All 13 sections cleanly split under /components/hero/. heroData.js (228 lines) holds static constants only. Excellent refactor — was 1039 lines, now far below 700-line guideline.
Self-heal background task lifecycle: spawned on startup via asyncio.create_task and cancelled on shutdown via app.state.stripe_healer_task (server.py lines 148-160). Correct lifecycle handling.

test_stripe_self_heal.py covers all 7 expected scenarios (placeholder detection, fresh-left-alone, stale+unreachable, stale+paid reconciliation, stale+stripe-expired, stale+open-left-pending, mixed-batch). FakeDB pattern keeps tests fast (0.09s) and dependency-free.
Minor: cancel_stale_pending_checkouts sets expired_at=None when status=='complete' (reconciled paid). Could omit the field instead of setting None to keep doc shape cleaner, but functionally fine.

success_rate.backend: 100% (health 200, self-heal 7/7 unit tests, create-checkout 3/3 valid packages, admin login OK, self-heal loop log confirmed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 sections, EncryptedText final reveal, 3/3 CTAs, /diagnose nav, 6/6 apple cards, modal open + ESC close, carousel-next, admin sessionStorage token, 0 console errors)
